## Design

### 2026-10-10 – I started this thing and intend to finish it tonight, I will be back with more hours. I have no clue how to make a PCB so I was confused and it took me a while, but now I just have to write the code!

**4h**

I started this thing and intend to finish it tonight, I will be back with more hours. I have no clue how to make a PCB so I was confused and it took me a while, but now I just have to write the code! (yay i will be up til' 2am :D). I made my PCB routing slightly cursed but we're going with "modern art." And I made my BOM. I didn't know we were supposed to take photos of the project as we made it so these are all after I made the project.
